_help: Freshers trail: the first places a new student should find, in order. DRAFT: the team must check the order and every tip. Yoruba tips still to be written (the app shows English until then).

tip.en: A good starting point: most routes in this app begin here.
tip.pcm: Na better place to start: most road for this app dey start from here.

tip.en: Ask here which admission and clearance papers you need.
tip.pcm: Ask for here the admission and clearance papers wey you need.

tip.en: Know where it is before you need it. The number is on the Emergency page.
tip.pcm: Know where e dey before you need am. The number dey for Emergency page.

tip.en: The main library. Ask at the desk how to register.
tip.pcm: The main library. Ask for the desk how to register.

tip.en: Students call it SUB. A common meeting point.
tip.pcm: Students dey call am SUB. Na where people dey meet.
Dem also dey call am CBT Centre.
